title: Mapo Tofu Stir Fry
description: A classic Sichuan dish made with tofu, chili peppers, and spices. Quick and easy to make, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the Sichuan peppercorns and stir-fry for another 30 seconds.
Add the tofu and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add the light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and sesame oil, and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the chili peppers and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Stir in the green onions and serve immediately.
Cook the tofu to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
